item.title: Kwanhun Club Presents Plaque of Appreciation to U.S. Embassy in Seoul … "Gratitude for Contributions to Korean Media and Democracy" (관훈클럽, 주한 미국대사관에 감사패 수여 …“韓 언론·민주주의 기여에 감사”)
item.description:
Kwanhun Club Presents Plaque of Appreciation to U.S. Embassy in Seoul … "Gratitude for Contributions to Korean Media and Democracy" ( 관훈클럽, 주한 미국대사관에 감사패 수여 …“韓 언론·민주주의 기여에 감사”)

The Kwanhun Club presented a plaque of appreciation to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul on the 1st for its efforts in advancing Korean media and strengthening South Korea-U.S. relations. (관훈클럽이 1일 한국 언론 발전과 한미 관계 증진을 위해 애써온 주한미국대사관에 감사패를 수여했다.)

The Kwanhun Club announced that it held a ceremony titled "Commemorating the 250th Anniversary of the Founding of the United States – Plaque of Appreciation to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul" at the Korea Press Center in Jung-gu, Seoul, on the same day. The Kwanhun Club is a press organization founded in 1957, centered around journalists who had undergone training across the United States with support from the U.S. Embassy in Seoul and affiliated U.S. government agencies after the Korean War. (관훈클럽은 이날 서울 중구 한국프레스센터에서 ‘미국 건국 250주년 기념 주한미국대사관 감사패 수여식’을 개최했다고 밝혔다. 관훈클럽은 6·25 전쟁 이후 주한미국대사관과 미국 정부 관련 기관의 지원을 받아 미국 각지로 연수를 다녀온 언론인을 중심으로 1957년 창립된 언론 단체다.)

The presentation of the plaque is also known to carry the significance of celebrating the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. Since the establishment of the Kwanhun Club, the U.S. Embassy in Seoul has supported various publications, international exchange projects, and journalist training programs published by the club, contributing to the development of South Korea's media landscape and the enhancement of mutual understanding between South Korea and the United States. (이번 감사패 수여는 미국 건국 250주년을 축하하는 의미도 담긴 것으로 알려졌다. 주한미국대사관은 관훈클럽 창립 후 관훈클럽에서 발간하는 각종 간행물과 국제교류 사업, 언론인 교육 프로그램 등을 지원하며 대한민국 언론계의 발전과 한미 양국 간 상호 이해 증진에 기여해 왔다.)

Approximately 30 people from various sectors attended the event, including James Heller, Chargé d'Affaires of the U.S. Embassy in Seoul, and other embassy officials, National Assembly member Kim Geon, Jeong Yeon-doo, Director General for Foreign Policy and Strategy at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kim Jong-wook, Honorary Chairman of the KATUSA Association, and Shin Beom-cheol, former Vice Minister of National Defense. (이날 행사에는 제임스 헬러 주한미국대사관 대사대리를 비롯한 미국대사관 관계자들과 김건 국회의원, 정연두 외교부 외교전략정보본부장, 김종욱 카투사연합회 명예회장, 신범철 전 국방부 차관 등 각계 인사 약 30명이 참석했다.)

Lee Ha-won, the 73rd Secretary-General of the Kwanhun Club, stated, "The Kwanhun Club was founded in 1957, led by young journalists who had undergone training in the United States with assistance from the U.S. Embassy in Seoul," adding, "We express our gratitude to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul for its long-standing contributions to the development of Korean media and democracy." (이하원 제73대 관훈클럽 총무는 “관훈클럽은 1957년 주한 미국 대사관의 도움 등으로 미국 연수를 다녀온 젊은 기자들이 주축이 돼 창립됐다”며 “오랜 시간 동안 한국 언론과 민주주의 발전에 기여해 온 주한 미국 대사관에 감사의 뜻을 표한다”고 말했다.)

Chargé d'Affaires James Heller said, "As the United States marks its 250th founding anniversary this year, it is even more meaningful to commemorate this occasion with the Kwanhun Club," and added, "The members of the Kwanhun Club have consistently demonstrated expertise, integrity, and public spirit in their roles as journalists, and I deeply appreciate these efforts." (제임스 헬러 대사 대리는 “미국이 올해 건국 250주년을 맞이한 시점에서 관훈클럽과 이를 기념하게 돼 더욱 뜻깊게 생각한다”며 “관훈클럽 회원들은 전문성을 갖고 청렴하게 (언론인으로서) 공공정신을 몸소 실천해 왔는데, 이 같은 노고에 깊이 감사드린다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Government: "23,403 Drug Offenders Apprehended Last Year… Record High Seizure of Illicit Drugs Entering from Overseas" (정부 “지난해 마약사범 2만3403명 검거… 해외 유입 마약 적발 역대 최대”)
item.description:
Government: "23,403 Drug Offenders Apprehended Last Year… Record High Seizure of Illicit Drugs Entering from Overseas" (정부 “지난해 마약사범 2만3403명 검거… 해외 유입 마약 적발 역대 최대”)

The government announced that it has made a total effort to combat drug-related crimes, apprehending 23,403 drug offenders last year and forcibly repatriating fugitives who had fled abroad. (정부가 마약류 범죄에 총력 대응해 지난해 마약류 사범 2만3403명을 검거하고, 해외 도피 사범들을 강제 송환했다고 밝혔다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, the National Police Agency, the Korea Coast Guard, the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, and the Korea Customs Service released these "Major Achievements in Drug Crime Response" on the 1st, ahead of the first anniversary of the Lee Jae-myung administration. (국무조정실과 법무부, 보건복지부, 대검찰청, 경찰청, 해양경찰청, 식품의약품안전처, 관세청은 이재명 정부 출범 1주년을 앞두고 1일 이 같은 내용의 ‘마약류 범죄 대응 주요 성과’를 발표했다.)

According to the government, in the 10 months from last June to this April following the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, 5,386 online drug offenders were apprehended, and 3,233 kg of drugs brought in from overseas were seized, setting a record high for the same period. (정부에 따르면, 이재명 정부 출범 후 지난해 6월부터 올해 4월까지 10개월간 온라인 마약 사범 5386명을 검거하고 해외에서 반입되는 마약류 3233㎏을 적발해, 역대 같은 기간 최고치를 기록했다.)

The 'Special Task Force for Transnational Crime' established by the government successfully repatriated Park Wang-yeol, who was smuggling large quantities of drugs from the Philippines into South Korea, and the National Police Agency apprehended and repatriated Choi Byung-min, who supplied drugs to Park Wang-yeol. In addition, last November, a 'Joint Government Drug Crime Investigation Headquarters' was formed with specialized investigators from the prosecution, police, coast guard, and customs service. In the subsequent six months, 235 individuals from eight organized crime groups were booked, with 109 of them detained. (정부가 구성한 ‘초국가범죄 특별 대응 TF(태스크포스)’는 필리핀에서 한국으로 마약을 대규모로 유입시키던 박왕열을 국내 송환하는 데 성공했고, 경찰청은 박왕열에게 마약을 공급한 최병민을 검거·송환했다. 이 밖에도 지난해 11월 검찰·경찰·해경·관세청의 전문 수사 인력으로 ‘마약범죄 정부합동수사본부’를 구성해, 이후 6개월 사이에 조직 범죄 집단 8개 세력 등의 235명을 입건했고, 이 가운데 109명을 구속했다.)

The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, in collaboration with the police and local governments, conducted crackdowns on medical institutions, uncovering 44 cases of misuse or abuse of ADHD medications and propofol, as well as fraudulent use of deceased individuals' or others' identities. They also apprehended six individuals who illegally distributed 160,000 ampoules of etomidate, a general anesthetic, and arrested doctors who overprescribed or abused drugs, as well as a doctor who falsified reports to cover up a death from illegal propofol use. The Korea Customs Service introduced a dual inspection system, where international mail that passes initial screening at airports and ports is re-examined with X-rays upon arrival at mail distribution centers, leading to the detection of illegal drugs. (식약처는 경찰, 지방자치단체와 함께 의료기관을 단속해 ADHD(주의력 결핍 행동장애) 치료제와 프로포폴 오·남용, 사망자·타인 명의 도용 등으로 44곳을 적발했다. 또 전신 마취제인 에토미데이트 앰플 16만개를 불법으로 유통시킨 6명을 검거하고, 마약류를 오남용 처방한 의사, 프로포폴 불법 사용으로 인한 사망을 숨기기 위해 허위 보고한 의사를 검거했다. 관세청은 공항·항만에서 1차 검사를 통과한 국제 우편물이 우편집중국에 도착하면 다시 한번 X선으로 검사하는 이중 검사 체계를 도입해 불법 마약류를 적발했다.)

The Ministry of Health and Welfare increased the budget for treatment cost support for drug addicts from 720 million won last year to 1.35 billion won this year, and expanded regional treatment and protection institutions from 9 to 11. It also decided to newly train 80 treatment and rehabilitation professionals this year. The Ministry of Justice developed a customized rehabilitation program called 'Recovery Connection Process' for correctional facilities and increased the number of dedicated rehabilitation correctional facilities from 4 to 6. (복지부는 마약류 중독자 치료를 늘리기 위해 치료비 지원 예산을 지난해 7억2000만원에서 올해 1억3500만원으로 늘렸고, 권역별 치료 보호 기관을 9곳에서 11곳으로 늘렸다. 치료·재활 전문 인력도 80명을 올해 신규로 양성하기로 했다. 법무부는 교정 시설 내 맞춤형 재활 프로그램인 ‘회복이음과정’을 개발하고, 재활 전담 교정 시설을 4곳에서 6곳으로 늘렸다.)

The government also stated that undercover investigations and covert operations to catch drug distribution organizations have been legalized, and the number of drugs that can be checked for patients' prescription history before medical institutions prescribe them has been increased from 3 to 5 types. (정부는 또 마약 유통 조직을 잡아내기 위한 신분 비공개 수사, 위장 수사가 법제화됐고, 의료기관에서 마약류를 처방하기 전 환자의 투약 이력을 확인할 수 있는 약품도 3종에서 5종으로 늘어났다고 밝혔다.)

Yoon Chang-ryeol, the head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, said, "As there are still many tasks ahead, such as strengthening crackdowns on smuggling routes, improving systems to prevent illegal distribution, upgrading detection equipment, and enhancing treatment, rehabilitation, and prevention efforts, we will maintain a state of vigilance and continue robust, whole-of-government responses." (윤창렬 국무조정실장은 “밀반입 경로별 단속 강화, 불법 유통 방지 제도 개선, 탐지 장비 고도화, 치료·재활·예방 내실화 등 아직 과제가 산적해 있는 만큼, 긴장의 끈을 놓지 않고 강력한 범정부 대응을 지속해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Visits Hanwha Aerospace Accident Site…“Conduct a Thorough Investigation into the Cause” (金총리, 한화에어로 사고 현장 방문… “원인 철저히 규명하라”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Visits Hanwha Aerospace Accident Site…“Conduct a Thorough Investigation into the Cause” (金총리, 한화에어로 사고 현장 방문… “원인 철저히 규명하라”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok on the 1st visited the Hanwha Aerospace plant in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, where an explosion accident occurred, urging a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and support for the bereaved families. (김민석 국무총리가 1일 폭발 사고가 일어난 대전 유성구 한화에어로스페이스 공장을 찾아 사고 원인에 대한 철저한 조사와 유가족 지원을 당부했다.)

After receiving a briefing on the damage situation at the accident site that afternoon, Prime Minister Kim, upon hearing that an on-site forensic examination was scheduled for the next day, asked, “Is it difficult to speculate on the cause at this point?” (김 총리는 이날 오후 사고 현장에서 피해 상황을 보고받은 뒤 내일 현장 감식이 예정돼 있다는 설명을 듣고 “현재까지는 (사고 원인을) 추정하기 어려운가”라고 물었다.)

Kim Ki-seon, head of the Yuseong Fire Station, replied, “Since it’s the cleaning process room and the items used are non-flammable, we need to conduct an investigation first.” (김기선 유성소방서장은 “(사고 지점이) 세척 공정실이고, 사용하는 물품들도 비인화성 물품들이라 조사를 해봐야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim further explained, “This plant also had gunpowder explosion accidents in the past, in 2018 and 2019.” Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Young-hoon added, “Previously, explosions occurred during the fuel injection process, but this time, it has been reported that the explosion occurred for the first time in the final stage of the cleaning process.” (김 서장은 이어 “이 공장에서 과거에도 2018년, 2019년에 화약 (폭발) 사고가 있었다”고 설명했다. 김영훈 고용노동부 장관은 “이전에는 연료 주입 과정에서 폭발이 일어났는데, 이번에는 세척하는 과정의 마지막 단계에서 처음으로 (폭발이 일어난 것으로) 보고됐다”고 덧붙였다.)

Prime Minister Kim then inquired about the funeral preparation status. In response, Minister Kim stated, “We cannot identify which remains belong to whom,” adding, “We need to conduct a thorough DNA analysis.” An official from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety explained, “We expect the identification results to be available as early as tomorrow evening or the day after tomorrow.” (김 총리는 이어 장례 준비 상황을 물었다. 이에 대해 김 장관은 “(시신 각각이) 어느 분인지는 알 수 없다”며 “DNA 분석을 면밀하게 해야 한다”고 했다. 행정안전부 담당자는 “이르면 내일 저녁, 아니면 모레에 신원 확인 결과가 나올 것으로 예상한다”고 설명했다.)

Prime Minister Kim urged the Ministry of Employment and Labor, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, and local governments, “Please take good care of the bereaved families together, making sure they have no difficulties.” (김 총리는 노동부와 행안부, 지방자치단체에 “함께 유가족을 잘 모셔 주시고 어려움이 없도록 챙겨 달라”고 당부했다.)

Meanwhile, an official from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety reported, “Among the deceased, one had a father working here, and another had a son working here together.” That is, of the two victims, one was working alongside their father, and the other alongside their son at this plant when the accident occurred. (한편 행안부 담당자는 “돌아가신 분들 중에 한 분은 아버지, 한 분은 아들이 이곳에 같이 근무한다”고 보고했다. 사망자 2명 가운데 1명은 이 공장에서 아버지와 함께, 다른 1명은 아들과 함께 근무하다가 사고를 당했다는 것이다.)

The Prime Minister’s Office stated that Prime Minister Kim instructed the Ministry of Employment and Labor and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety to “thoroughly analyze this accident, clearly identify its cause, and promptly implement necessary improvement measures to prevent similar accidents from recurring.” (총리실은 김 총리가 노동부와 행안부에 “이번 사고를 철저히 분석해 원인을 명확하게 규명하고, 유사 사고가 재발하지 않도록 필요한 개선 조치를 신속히 추진하라”고 지시했다고 밝혔다.)

It also conveyed that Prime Minister Kim urged, “All workplaces should move beyond merely following safety rules in a perfunctory manner and thoroughly operate a field-centered safety prevention system that works in practice.” (또 김 총리가 “모든 사업장은 형식적인 안전 수칙 준수에서 벗어나, 실질적으로 작동하는 현장 중심의 안전 예방 체계를 철저히 가동해 달라”고 당부했다고 전했다.)

Earlier, at around 10:59 a.m. that day, an explosion and fire occurred at the Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon plant, resulting in five deaths and two injuries. One of the two injured individuals is reported to be in critical condition. This plant is a facility that produces equipment related to the aviation, defense, and space industries. (앞서 이날 오전 10시 59분쯤 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 폭발과 화재가 일어나 5명이 숨지고 2명이 다쳤다. 부상자 2명 가운데 1명은 중태인 것으로 전해졌다. 이 공장은 항공·방산·우주 산업 관련 장비를 생산하는 시설이다.)

item.title: Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers "Strengthen Cooperation on Maritime Routes and Critical Minerals" (韓·아프리카 외교장관 “해상운송로·핵심광물 협력 강화”)
item.description:
Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers "Strengthen Cooperation on Maritime Routes and Critical Minerals" (韓·아프리카 외교장관 “해상운송로·핵심광물 협력 강화”)

The foreign ministers of South Korea and African nations adopted a joint statement in Seoul on the 1st, expressing their commitment to expanding cooperation between the two sides. (한·아프리카 외교장관들이 1일 서울에서 양측의 협력 확대 의지를 담은 공동성명을 채택했다.)

Foreign ministers and vice ministers from various African countries, heads of four regional international organizations, and South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul held the "2026 Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers' Meeting" at Lotte Hotel in Jung-gu, Seoul on that day. (아프리카 각국의 외교 장·차관, 역내 4개 국제기구 수장, 조현 외교부 장관 등은 이날 서울 중구 롯데호텔에서 ’2026 한-아프리카 외교장관회의’를 개최했다.)

In the joint statement released after the meeting, they stated that they discussed "geopolitical instability, the current situations in Ukraine and the Middle East, and their impact on the global economy, particularly Africa and South Korea." (이들은 회의 후 발표한 공동성명에서 “지정학적 불안정, 우크라이나와 중동의 현 상황, 그리고 그것이 세계 경제와 특히 아프리카 및 한국에 미치는 영향” 등을 논의했다고 밝혔다.)

They noted, "The strategic importance of Africa is increasingly growing, including in terms of maritime transport routes and resources such as critical minerals," adding, "We assessed this as a valuable opportunity to deepen and strengthen the relationship between both sides (Korea and Africa)." They also stated, "Recognizing the potential for cooperation between South Korea and Africa, we confirmed the need to enhance mutually beneficial economic cooperation." (그러면서 “해상 운송로와 핵심 광물을 포함한 자원 측면에서 아프리카의 전략적 중요성이 점차 증대되고 있다”며 “우리는 이를 양측(한-아프리카) 관계를 심화·강화할 소중한 기회로 평가했다”고 밝혔다. 또 “한국과 아프리카 간 협력의 잠재력을 인식하며, 상호 호혜적인 경제협력을 강화할 필요성을 확인했다”고 했다.)

In the statement, they reaffirmed their commitment to implementing the outcomes of the "Korea-Africa Summit" held in South Korea in June 2024 and welcomed South Korea's proposal to host the "2029 Korea-Africa Summit." (성명에서 이들은 2024년 6월 한국에서 개최됐던 ‘한국 아프리카 정상회의’의 성과를 이행하겠다는 의지를 재확인하고, 한국의 ’2029년 한국-아프리카 정상회의' 개최 제안도 환영했다.)

The meeting was held with the participation of diplomatic representatives from 50 African countries and heads of four regional international organizations, including the African Union (AU), the African Development Bank (AfDB), the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC). (이번 회의는 아프리카 50국의 외교 대표자들과 아프리카연합(AU), 아프리카개발은행(AfDB), 아프리카대륙자유무역지대(AfCFTA), 아프리카 질병통제예방센터(아프리카 CDC) 등 역내 4개 국제기구 수장 등이 참석한 가운데 진행됐다.)

This marks the first time the government has invited all African countries and regional organizations to host a foreign ministers' meeting. Held under the theme "Korea-Africa Partnership for Joint Response in the Era of Global Transition," participants extensively discussed ways to strengthen cooperation between South Korea and Africa. (정부가 전체 아프리카 국가와 지역기구를 초청해 외교장관회의를 개최한 것은 이번이 처음이다. ‘글로벌 전환기 속 공동 대응을 위한 한-아프리카 파트너십’을 주제로 열린 이번 회의에서 참석자들은 한국과 아프리카의 협력 강화 방안을 광범위하게 논의했다.)

In his opening remarks, Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul said, "The world is facing complex challenges in various areas such as supply chains, energy, and food security," and stressed, "Close cooperation between Korea and Africa is more important than ever." (조현 외교부 장관은 이날 개회사에서 “세계가 공급망, 에너지, 식량안보 등 다양한 분야에서 복합적 도전에 직면하고 있다”며 “한-아프리카의 긴밀한 협력은 어느 때보다 중요하다”고 했다.)

Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Minister for Foreign Affairs of Ghana—which serves as this year's vice chair of the African Union (AU) and co-chaired the meeting—stated, "Africa and South Korea have complementary strengths and enormous potential for mutually beneficial cooperation." (회의를 공동 주재한 올해 아프리카연합(AU) 부의장국 가나의 사무엘 오쿠제토 아블라콰 외교장관은 “아프리카와 한국은 상호 보완적인 강점을 갖고 있으며 상호 이익이 되는 협력에서 막대한 잠재력이 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: D-2 Gyeongnam Governor Election Heats Up with Allegations of Deepfake Videos and Election Interference (D-2 경남도지사 선거, ‘딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹’ 공방 격화)
item.description:
D-2 Gyeongnam Governor Election Heats Up with Allegations of Deepfake Videos and Election Interference (D-2 경남도지사 선거, ‘딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹’ 공방 격화)

With two days left until voting day, the June 3 local elections for Gyeongnam governor are intensifying as the ruling and opposition parties clash over allegations of "deepfake video production and distribution" and "election interference involving public officials." The Democratic Party of Korea is launching an offensive, claiming "organized election interference with civil servant involvement," while the People Power Party counters by calling it "political manipulation." Both sides are filing complaints against each other, engaging in a war of truth, and with a whistleblower even stepping forward, the dispute is devolving into a mudslinging match. <<> On the 1st, Democratic Party candidate Kim's spokesperson, Kim Myeong-seop, held a press conference at the Gyeongnam Provincial Government building, calling on the Changwon District Prosecutors' Office to swiftly secure evidence and investigate nine individuals—including former and current Gyeongnam provincial government employees and staff of candidate Park's election campaign—who were referred for investigation by the Gyeongnam Election Commission on suspicion of violating the Public Official Election Act. <<> Spokesperson Kim stated, "Nine people, including individuals linked to candidate Park's campaign and former and current public officials, were simultaneously referred by the Election Commission to the Changwon District Prosecutors' Office for investigation. This is truly an illegal election interference and AI fake video gate." He added, "Reports say the whistleblower not only informed the Election Commission about the production and distribution of fake videos but also about the operation of a mock election office. This whistleblower is not from our side but someone who was part of candidate Park's campaign." <<> In response, candidate Park Wan-soo's campaign senior spokesperson, Yoo Hae-nam, also held a press conference, fully refuting the allegations, claiming, "Candidate Kim's side is inflating baseless suspicions in the final stages of the election." <<> Spokesperson Yoo asserted, "Candidate Park's campaign never ordered the production of such videos, did not organize their distribution, and did not post them on the official YouTube channel." He also denied the existence of a "deepfake task force." He said, "Candidate Kim's side claims candidate Park's campaign produced and distributed deepfake videos. If there is even one piece of evidence video, present it. Candidate Kim's camp is hiding behind the whistleblower's one-sided claims and media reports, only fueling suspicions." <<> Regarding the filing of a complaint against the media outlet and reporter that reported on the allegations, he stated, "This is not intimidation of the press, but a legitimate legal measure to prevent voters' judgment from being clouded by the spread of false information." <<> Previously, on May 31, candidate Park's campaign stated, "We have criminally charged informant A, who spread false information as if we operated a deepfake-dedicated team and ordered the production and distribution of illegal deepfake videos, as well as the reporter who reported on this without verifying the facts." Spokesperson Yoo said, "We expect a comprehensive investigation through the prosecution's complaint, and once the investigation confirms the whistleblower's claims, we believe the suspicions will be resolved quickly." <<> This dispute was sparked on May 28, when a media outlet reported, "According to revelations by employee A, who worked for candidate Park Wan-soo's campaign, the campaign had dedicated personnel producing deepfake videos. In this process, AI deepfake videos defaming candidate Kim Gyeong-soo were produced and distributed, and there are indications that Gyeongnam provincial government employees were involved." <<> The Public Official Election Act prohibits the production, editing, and distribution of illegal AI fake videos for election campaign purposes from 90 days before the election. It also prohibits public officials from exerting undue influence or affecting election outcomes. <<> The Gyeongnam provincial government employees named by whistleblower A are fixed-term public servants in political roles, appointed during candidate Park's tenure as Gyeongnam governor. They resigned at the end of April when Park registered as a preliminary candidate and joined his campaign. One is reportedly still serving as a public official. If, before the end of April, they, as incumbent officials, instructed A to produce videos or provided materials, they may have violated the neutrality obligation of public servants in elections. <<> Following the report, candidate Kim's campaign filed a complaint with the Gyeongnam Provincial Police Agency on May 29 against candidate Park's campaign for alleged violations of the Public Official Election Act and the Local Public Officials Act. <<> As the dispute between the ruling and opposition parties turns into a mudslinging match, whistleblower A has also stepped forward. He held his own press conference that afternoon, introducing himself, "From April 14 to May 6, I worked on video production in candidate Park's campaign." A reportedly surrendered and reported to the Gyeongnam Provincial Election Commission on May 6, stating he was involved in illegal election activities. <<> He claimed, "On the evening of April 13, I received an external hard drive containing numerous videos from a car of a special advisor in Gyeongnam Province. It is clear that I was instructed to produce many videos around the time when one resigns as governor to engage in election activities." This implies he received materials from a public official. The hard drive A received reportedly contained videos and materials related to incumbent governor candidate Park Wan-soo, created by the Gyeongnam Provincial Government's Public Relations Office and Publicity Office from 2023 to 2026. <<> A stated that based on these materials, he produced one music video and 19 shorts while working in candidate Park's campaign. Among these, the music video utilized deepfake technology and is known to contain content defaming candidate Kim. However, A clarified, "The music video using deepfake was not directly ordered by candidate Park's campaign; I uploaded it to my personal YouTube channel and then took it down." <<> A also claimed that while he was not involved, another video production team produced and distributed numerous shorts using deepfake technology. He said, "Under the direction of former Gyeongnam provincial government employees and a company that can be seen as an external organization, they systematically operated a YouTube channel, posting and distributing 32 short-form videos from mid-March to April 28 that constitute deepfake content." <<> He added, "I apologize to the residents of the province and to candidate Kim Gyeong-soo, the victim, for obscuring the fair election process through my unwitting involvement." (투표일을 이틀 앞둔 6·3지방선거 경남도지사 선거가 여야의 ‘딥페이크 영상 제작 및 배포·관권선거 의혹’ 공방으로 격화되고 있다. 더불어민주당은 “공무원이 개입한 조직적 관권선거”라고 공세를 퍼붓고 있고, 국민의힘에서는 “정치공작”이라며 맞서는 상황이다. 양측이 서로를 고발하며, 진실 공방을 벌이는 상황에서 의혹 제보자까지 등판해 진흙탕 싸움으로 번지고 있다.)

item.title: Park Min-sik: "Han Dong-hoon’s Illegal Election Campaign"... Han Dong-hoon: "Park is Jang Dong-hyuk’s Avatar" (박민식 “韓, 불법 선거운동”... 한동훈 “朴, 장동혁 아바타”)
item.description:
Park Min-sik: "Han Dong-hoon’s Illegal Election Campaign"... Han Dong-hoon: "Park is Jang Dong-hyuk’s Avatar" (박민식 “韓, 불법 선거운동”... 한동훈 “朴, 장동혁 아바타”)

On May 1st, Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate, and Han Dong-hoon, an independent candidate, both running in the June 3rd by-election for Busan’s Buk-gu District, held separate press conferences and engaged in a war of words against each other. (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 국민의힘 박민식 후보와 무소속 한동훈 후보가 1일 각자 기자회견을 열고 서로를 향해 공방을 벌였다.)

Candidate Park Min-sik held a press conference at his election office at 3:30 PM that day, referencing the allegations of operating a 'quasi-campaign office' tied to candidate Han Dong-hoon. Earlier, the Busan Metropolitan Election Commission was reported to have requested a police investigation into whether the Public Official Election Act had been violated, concerning suspicions that individuals presumed to be supporters of Han had operated a quasi-campaign office under the guise of a 'volunteer rest area.' (박민식 후보는 이날 오후 3시 30분 선거사무소에서 기자회견을 열고 한동훈 후보와 관련해 제기된 ‘유사 선거사무소 운영 의혹’을 언급했다. 앞서 부산시선거관리위원회는 최근 한 후보의 지지자로 추정되는 인물들이 ‘자원봉사자 쉼터’라는 명목으로 유사 선거사무소를 운영했다는 의혹과 관련해 공직선거법 위반 여부를 판단하기 위해 경찰에 수사 의뢰를 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Candidate Park stated, "I understand there are various controversies surrounding candidate Han, including the rest area and chartered buses," and added, "Whether it's the Election Commission or the police, they must swiftly and actively investigate." He further said, "(Candidate Han) must clearly state whether it's true or false. Personally, I have rarely filed complaints or accusations during elections, but in cases like this, I believe a strong response is necessary." (박 후보는 “한 후보는 쉼터, 동원 버스 등 여러 논란이 있는 것으로 안다”며 “선거관리위원회든 경찰이든 신속하고 적극적으로 파악해야 한다”고 했다. 이어 그는 “(한 후보가) 아니면 아니다 기면 기라고 명명백백하게 밝혀줘야 한다”며 “개인적으로 선거 때 고소·고발을 해본 적이 거의 없는데 이런 경우는 따끔하게 대응해야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Park commented, "I feel daily that candidate Han’s (recent poll numbers showing) 40-something percent support are inflated with massive bubbles," and described Han as "someone who would use Buk-gu as a disposable fire starter for political ambition and then discard it." He then asserted, "Only I, Park Min-sik, have genuine sincerity for Buk-gu’s development," and vowed, "I will repay the fervent unity and aspirations of the conservative support base with certain victory." (박 후보는 “한 후보가 (최근 여론조사 결과 지지율이) 40 몇 퍼센트(를 기록)하는 게 엄청난 거품이 끼어있다는 것을 매일 체감한다”며 “정치적 야심을 위해 북구를 일회용 불쏘시개로 쓰고 내팽개칠 사람”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “북구 발전에 진정성을 가진 사람은 오직 저 박민식뿐”이라면서 “보수 지지층의 뜨거운 결집과 열망을 반드시 필승으로 보답하겠다”고 했다.)

In contrast, candidate Han Dong-hoon said at a press conference held at his election office at 3:00 PM that day, "President Lee Jae-myung sent his avatar directly to jump into this election, and Jang Dong-hyuk’s faction within the party has also put forward candidate Park Min-sik as their avatar," adding, "Only by overcoming both of these can Korea’s future exist." This was aimed at both Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and candidate Park. (반면 한동훈 후보는 이날 오후 3시 선거사무소에서 열린 기자회견에서 “이재명 대통령이 직접 아바타를 보내 이번 선거에 뛰어 들었고, 장동혁 당권파 역시 박민식 후보를 아바타로 내세웠다”며 “그 두 가지 모두를 극복해야만 대한민국의 미래가 있다”고 말했다. 더불어민주당 하정우 후보와 박 후보를 모두 겨냥한 것이다.)

Han stated, "The June 3rd by-election in Busan’s Buk-gu District is the opportunity to show the Democratic Party regime and the party faction (supporting Jang Dong-hyuk within the People Power Party) where the true public sentiment lies," and urged, "Please rally your votes for me so I can straighten the balance of Korea, where the right wing has been broken, and crush the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung regime." He also asked, "Who else in the National Assembly can fight and win against the 180 seats (of the Democratic Party) and stop excesses like the 'cancellation of indictment' (special counsel)?" (한 후보는 “민주당 정권과 (국민의힘에서 장동혁 대표를 지지하는) 당권파에게 진짜 민심이 어디에 있는지를 보여줄 기회가 바로 6월 3일 부산 북갑의 재·보궐선거”라면서 “오른쪽 날개가 꺾인 대한민국의 균형추를 맞춰 이재명 정권의 폭주를 박살 낼 수 있도록 제게 표를 몰아달라”고 했다. 그는 “누가 국회에 있어야만 (민주당 의석) 180석을 상대로 싸워서 이기고 ‘공소 취소’ (특검) 같은 폭주를 막을 수 있겠는가”라고도 했다.)

Regarding suspicions raised by some in the Democratic Party about "organized false address changes by Han Dong-hoon supporters," Han refuted, "They are firing off various slander circulating on online communities as if it’s a bygone-era election, and to avoid election laws, candidate Ha Jung-woo is using the party instead of doing it himself." (한 후보는 민주당 일각에서 ‘한동훈 후보 지지자들의 조직적 위장 전입’ 의혹이 제기된 데 대해 “마치 쌍팔년도 선거를 보듯이 커뮤니티에 떠도는 각종 마타도어를 선거 막판에 난사하고 있다”며 “선거법을 피하기 위해 하정우 후보가 직접 하지 않고 당을 이용하고 있다”고 반박했다.)

item.title: Xi Jinping’s Visit to North Korea Imminent? Structure Believed to Be a Reviewing Stand Being Set Up at Kim Il-sung Square (시진핑 방북 임박했나… 사열대 추정 구조물, 김일성 광장에 설치중)
item.description:
Xi Jinping’s Visit to North Korea Imminent? Structure Believed to Be a Reviewing Stand Being Set Up at Kim Il-sung Square (시진핑 방북 임박했나… 사열대 추정 구조물, 김일성 광장에 설치중)

Amid speculation that Chinese President Xi Jinping may visit North Korea, the U.S.-based North Korea specialist outlet NK News reported that the North is constructing a structure believed to be a reviewing stand at Pyongyang’s Kim Il-sung Square. North Korea has previously set up temporary reviewing stands for welcoming ceremonies for foreign dignitaries, such as Russian President Vladimir Putin, fueling speculation that Chairman Xi’s visit may be imminent. However, some sources suggest that early June may be difficult given China’s diplomatic schedule, including the visit of the Lao president to China from the 2nd to the 6th. (시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북 가능성이 제기된 가운데, 북한이 평양 김일성 광장에 사열대로 추정되는 구조물을 짓고 있다고 미국의 북한 전문 매체 ‘NK뉴스’가 최근 보도했다. 북한은 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령 등 외국 주요 인사를 맞는 환영식 때 사열대를 임시로 설치해와 시 주석의 방북이 임박한 것 아니냐는 추측이 나오고 있다. 다만 라오스 국가주석 방중(2~6일) 증 중국 측 외교 일정을 고려할 때 6월 초는 쉽지 않다는 이야기도 나온다.)

NK News analyzed a video taken in Pyongyang on May 26-27 by Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan during his visit to North Korea, reporting that a tall screen and a mobile crane were seen surrounding some structure inside Kim Il-sung Square. Using satellite imagery to pinpoint the screen’s location, the outlet found it matched the spot where a temporary stone reviewing stand had been erected for the welcoming ceremony during President Putin’s 2024 visit to North Korea. (NK뉴스는 지난달 26~27일 북한을 방문한 비비안 발라크리슈난 싱가포르 외교부 장관이 평양에서 촬영한 동영상을 분석해, 김일성 광장 내부에 어떤 구조물을 둘러싼 것으로 보이는 높은 가림막과 이동식 크레인의 모습이 확인된다고 전했다. 이 매체가 위성 사진을 이용해 가림막 위치를 분석해 보니, 2024년 푸틴 대통령 방북 당시 환영식에 쓰기 위해 임시로 설치했던 석조 사열대가 있던 자리였다.)

Since satellite images from May 24, two days before Balakrishnan’s visit, showed no such screen, NK News concluded that construction of the structure began in the interim. The outlet noted that the reviewing stand for Putin’s visit was installed eight days prior, suggesting that Chairman Xi could visit North Korea early this month. Recent satellite images of Pyongyang International Airport also reportedly show space prepared to accommodate multiple large aircraft, further indicating an imminent visit. (발라크리슈난 장관의 방북 이틀 전인 지난달 24일 위성 사진에는 가림막이 보이지 않았기 때문에, 그 사이에 구조물 설치 공사가 시작됐다는 것이 NK뉴스의 분석이다. 이 매체는 푸틴 대통령 방북 때 사열대 설치 작업은 방북 8일 전부터 시작됐다며, 이를 근거로 시 주석이 이달 초 방북할 가능성이 있다고 전했다. 최근 평양 국제공항을 찍은 위성 사진에서도 대형 항공기 여러 대를 수용할 수 있는 공간이 마련된 모습이 포착됐다고 한다. 이 역시 시 주석 방북이 임박한 정황이라는 것이다.)

Earlier, the U.S. news magazine Time reported on May 20, citing an anonymous source, that Chairman Xi plans to pay a state visit to North Korea soon. South Korea’s government is also said to have obtained intelligence on the possibility of Xi’s visit and is closely monitoring related developments. According to diplomatic sources, the North Korean embassy in Beijing received orders from Pyongyang to “arrange a summit with Chairman Xi,” after which the International Department of the Chinese Communist Party reportedly conducted an inspection visit to Pyongyang. (앞서 미국 시사 주간지 타임은 지난달 20일 익명 소식통을 인용해 시 주석이 조만간 북한을 국빈 방문할 예정이라고 보도했다. 우리 정부도 시 주석의 방북 가능성에 대한 첩보를 입수하고 관련 동향을 예의 주시 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 외교 소식통에 따르면 평양에서 베이징의 북한 대사관에 ‘시 주석과의 정상회담을 성사시키라’는 지령을 하달했고, 그 후 중국 공산당 대외연락부가 평양을 답사한 것으로 알려졌다.)

If Chairman Xi visits North Korea, it could be seen as a return visit for North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un’s attendance at last year’s Chinese military parade marking the 80th anniversary of victory in the War of Resistance Against Japan. Following President Putin’s visit to China last month, it would also signify the consolidation of solidarity among North Korea, China, and Russia. (시 주석이 방북한다면 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 지난해 중국 항일전쟁 승리 80주년 열병식에 참석한 데 대한 답방 성격으로 볼 수 있다. 푸틴 대통령이 지난달 중국을 방문한 데 이어, 북·중·러 간 연대가 공고화되는 의미도 있다.)

item.title: Security Experts Say "North Korea Promotes Hostile Two-State Theory to Threaten South Korea with Nuclear Weapons" (안보 전문가들 “北, 한국 핵 위협하려 적대적 두 국가론 내세워”)
item.description:
Security Experts Say "North Korea Promotes Hostile Two-State Theory to Threaten South Korea with Nuclear Weapons" (안보 전문가들 “北, 한국 핵 위협하려 적대적 두 국가론 내세워”)

Concerns have been raised that if South Korea acknowledges a "two-state relationship" between the two Koreas, it could strengthen North Korea's "hostile two-state theory" and intensify its threats against the South. Park Hyeong-jung, a former senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, made this statement at a conference held on the 1st by the Unification and Sharing Foundation at the Press Center in Jung-gu, Seoul, under the theme "Era of Turmoil—How to Reunite Unification and Peace." He described "North Korea's hostile two-state theory as a strategy for permanent coexistence on the Korean Peninsula with North Korea holding the upper hand." <<> In his presentation, Park stated, "Even if South Korea discards its unification discourse or transforms inter-Korean relations into a two-state relationship, North Korea will not abandon its hostile two-state theory or change inter-Korean relations to one of 'peaceful coexistence.'" He added, "The notion that if we offer goodwill first for peace, the other side will reciprocate with goodwill is a delusion that invites danger." He argued, "Even if we recognize the two Koreas as two states and refer to (North Korea's) official name, the structurally inherent hostility between the two sides, along with the institutional systems and interests that internalize it, will not budge at all." Recently, Unification Minister Kim Yung-ho and others have claimed that the two Koreas are effectively in a two-state situation and have urged referring to North Korea as the "Democratic People's Republic of Korea." <<> However, Park emphasized that North Korea's hostile two-state theory is "not simply a declaration of abandoning unification but an ideological preparation for implementing a nuclear coercion strategy against South Korea." He noted, "As long as the unification narrative is maintained, South Korea remains not just an enemy but part of a people to be reunified someday, which burdens North Korea's internal control." Therefore, he argued, "The hostile two-state theory is an attempt to block South Korea's absorptive gravitational appeal by reclassifying South Korea as an adversary rather than compatriots." <<> Kim Byung-yeon, a distinguished professor at Seoul National University, suggested on the same day, "I propose that integration, rather than unification or peace, be set as the goal of our government's North Korea policy." Professor Kim stated, "Let us define the process of inter-Korean relations in three stages—economic cooperation, economic integration, and unification—and tentatively pursue economic integration as a policy goal." He added, "A political system similar to the second stage of the national community unification plan, such as a confederation or a lower-level federation, is unrealistic." <<> Professor Emeritus Park Myung-kyu of Seoul National University said, "A simple coexistence theory not connected to unification cannot guarantee stable peace," and stressed that "unification and peace should be reconstructed as complementary rather than substitutive relationships." Professor Emeritus Cho Dong-ho of Ewha Womans University noted, "A dichotomous perspective of being for or against unification cannot capture the complex attitudes of the public or the complexity of the issue." He added, "We should not narrow our view just because the younger generation's perception of unification has weakened; instead, we must expand experiences and education about unification from a long-term perspective." (우리 측이 ‘남북 두 국가 관계’를 인정하면 북한의 ‘적대적 두 국가론’과 대남 위협을 강화하는 결과로 이어질 수 있다는 지적이 제기됐다. 박형중 전 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 1일 서울 중구 프레스센터에서 통일과나눔 재단이 ‘격동의 시대-통일과 평화 어떻게 재결합할 것인가’를 주제로 개최한 콘퍼런스에서 “북한의 적대적 두 국가론은 북한 우위의 남북 영구 병존 전략”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

item.title: Government Moves to Legislate Against Hate Speech and Discrimination (정부, 혐오 표현·차별 방지 법제화 시동)
item.description:
Government Moves to Legislate Against Hate Speech and Discrimination (정부, 혐오 표현·차별 방지 법제화 시동)

The Lee Jae-myung administration has announced that it will investigate overseas cases of anti-discrimination laws and, based on this, push forward with legislation to prevent hate speech and discrimination. The anti-discrimination law aims to prohibit discriminatory acts based on gender, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, and other factors. (이재명 정부가 차별금지법에 대한 해외 사례를 조사하고 이를 토대로 혐오 표현과 차별 방지 법제화에 나서겠다고 밝혔다. 차별금지법은 성별·장애·나이·성적 지향·종교 등을 이유로 한 차별 행위를 금지하는 내용이다.)

In a report titled "The Path of Great Transformation Created by the People," which outlines national achievements and tasks, the government stated on the 1st, "We will actively monitor legislative proposals for the Equality Act (Anti-Discrimination Law) in the National Assembly and pursue a 'survey on the implementation cases and impact of overseas anti-discrimination legislation,' thereby laying the groundwork for legislating against hate speech and discrimination." (정부는 1일 국정 성과와 과제를 담아 펴낸 ‘국민이 만든 대전환의 길’에서 “평등법(차별금지법) 국회 입법 발의에 대한 적극적인 모니터링과 ’해외 차별 금지 법제의 시행 사례 및 영향 실태 조사‘를 추진하면서 혐오 표현과 차별 방지 법제화를 위한 토대를 마련하고자 한다”고 밝혔다.)

The anti-discrimination law was first proposed as a government-initiated bill during the Roh Moo-hyun administration in 2007 and has since been introduced multiple times through parliamentary initiatives. However, legislation has stalled due to opposition from the Christian community, which views it as a "same-sex marriage legalization bill." During his presidential campaign, President Lee Jae-myung expressed support for the necessity of an anti-discrimination law but reserved his position, citing the need for sufficient social consensus. (차별금지법은 2007년 노무현 정부 때 정부 입법 형태로 처음 발의된 이후 의원 입법으로 여러 번 발의됐다. 하지만 “동성혼 합법화 법안”이라는 기독교계의 반발로 입법이 이어지지 않았다. 이재명 대통령도 지난 대선 때 차별금지법에 대한 필요성엔 찬성하나 충분한 사회적 합의가 필요하다며 입장을 보류했었다.)

◇ "Even criticizing homosexuality could lead to punishment" — Religious groups strongly oppose the anti-discrimination law (◇“동성애 비판만으로도 처벌받는다” 종교계는 차별금지법 강력 반대)

The left-leaning camp has pressured the government, arguing that "President Lee Jae-myung has been neglecting the anti-discrimination law since his election." Although a bill has been proposed in the National Assembly led by the Party for Justice and Innovation, substantive discussions have yet to take place. The government's announcement that it will monitor overseas cases and the legislative situation in the National Assembly is seen as a step toward preparing for legislation. (좌파 진영에서는 “이재명 대통령이 당선 이후 차별금지법에 소홀하다”며 압박해왔다. 현재 국회엔 조국혁신당 주도로 법안이 발의돼 있지만 지금까지 제대로 된 논의는 이뤄지지 않고 있다. 정부가 해외 사례와 국회 입법 상황을 모니터링하겠다고 밝힌 것은 법제화 준비 단계로 넘어가는 과정으로 해석된다.)

In February this year, the government established a "Basic Plan for Preventing Hate and Discrimination" and held the "First Forum on Responding to Hate and Discrimination," bringing together civil society organizations, researchers, and stakeholders focused on migrants, disabilities, and sexual minorities. It also co-hosted the "First Debate on Criteria for Judging Hate Speech" with the National Assembly Research Service and collaborated with the private sector to study "Overseas Cases and Challenges in Responding to Hate Speech." The Ministry of the Interior and Safety has since gathered opinions on the findings. (정부는 올 2월 ‘혐오차별 방지 기본계획’을 수립하고, 이주·장애·성소수자 관련 시민사회단체와 연구자 등 각계 구성원들과 함께 참여하는 ‘혐오차별대응 1차 포럼’을 개최했다. 국회입법조사처와 공동으로 1차 ‘혐오 표현 판단 기준에 관한 토론회’를 개최했고, 민간과 함께 ‘해외 혐오 표현 대응 사례와 과제’를 연구하기도 했다. 행정안전부는 이 연구 결과에 대한 의견 수렴을 진행했다.)

A government official stated, "Because the anti-discrimination law could be socially controversial, it is necessary to thoroughly gather public opinion and closely examine overseas cases. It will not be enacted in a short period." (정부 관계자는 “차별금지법은 사회적으로 논란이 될 수 있기 때문에 충분히 여론을 수렴하고, 해외 사례 또한 면밀히 들여다볼 필요가 있다”며 “단시일 내 입법이 되는 건 아니다”라고 했다.)

The core of the anti-discrimination law prohibits discriminatory acts based on gender, disability, age, sexual orientation, educational background, religion, country of origin, and employment type. In the 21st National Assembly, a bill including provisions on sexual orientation sparked heated controversy. (차별금지법은 성별·장애·나이·성적 지향·학력·종교·출신 국가·고용 형태 등을 이유로 한 차별 행위를 금지하는 내용이 핵심인데, 21대 국회에서도 성적 지향 등의 항목도 포함된 법안이 발의돼 논란이 격해졌다.)

The Christian community argues that if the anti-discrimination law is introduced, merely criticizing homosexuality could lead to punishment, infringing on religious freedom. They also claim that including sexual orientation and gender identity as grounds for prohibiting discrimination could undermine the order of the sexes and the institution of the family. (기독교계는 차별금지법이 도입되면 동성애를 비판하는 것만으로도 처벌받는 등 신앙의 자유가 침해될 수 있고, 성적 지향과 성별 정체성이 차별 금지 사유에 포함돼 남녀 질서와 가정을 파괴할 위험이 있다고 주장한다.)

Meanwhile, civil society groups have linked the issue to recent controversies, such as the debate over closing the far-right website 'Ilbe' and Starbucks' 'Tank Day' marketing incident. They argue that beyond shutting down Ilbe, which hosts far-right posts, the government should enact an anti-discrimination law regulating all forms of hate and discrimination. (반면 시민단체 등은 최근 ‘일간베스트(일베)’ 사이트 폐쇄 논란과 스타벅스의 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅 논란과 이 사안을 연계하고 있다. 극우 성향의 게시물이 올라오는 일베를 폐쇄하는 데서 나아가 모든 혐오와 차별을 규제할 수 있는 차별금지법을 제정해야 한다는 것이다.)

A ruling party official commented, "The anti-discrimination law is a sensitive issue. That's why the Lee Jae-myung administration is starting with a survey of overseas cases and looking at it from a long-term perspective." (여권 관계자는 “차별금지법은 민감한 의제”라며 “그래서 이재명 정부에서도 일단 해외 사례 조사부터 시작해 장기적으로 보자는 것”이라고 했다.)

Separately, the ruling party is preparing to propose an 'Ilbe Ban Law' soon. Since current information and communications network laws cannot be used to shut down Ilbe, the new law would establish a fresh legal basis. President Lee previously mentioned reviewing the closure of Ilbe on X (formerly Twitter) on the 24th of last month. He cited media reports that presumed Ilbe members insulted former President Roh Moo-hyun on the 23rd of last month at Bongha Village, where a memorial service was held. (이와 별도로 여권에서는 ‘일베 금지법’을 조만간 발의할 준비를 하고 있다. 현행 정보통신망법으로는 일베 폐쇄가 불가능하기 때문에 새롭게 근거를 만드는 내용으로 알려졌다. 앞서 이 대통령은 지난달 24일 X에서 ‘일베 폐쇄 검토’를 언급했다. 일베 회원으로 추정되는 이들이 지난달 23일 노무현 전 대통령의 추도식이 열린 봉하마을에서 노 전 대통령을 모욕하는 행위를 했다는 언론 보도를 이유로 들었다.)

President Lee stated, "Public debate and actual review seem necessary to allow measures such as closing sites that neglect or promote mockery and hate like Ilbe, punitive damages, and fines." His post garnered thousands of comments, with supporters saying, "Hate and mockery are not freedom of expression," and opponents arguing, "If it suits your taste, it's freedom of expression; if it doesn't, it's punishable — that's the beginning of dictatorship." The closure of Ilbe was previously the subject of a public petition during the Moon Jae-in administration in 2018, reviewed by the Blue House at the time, but it did not lead to an actual shutdown. (이 대통령은 “일베처럼 조롱·혐오를 방치·조장하는 사이트 폐쇄, 징벌 배상, 과징금 등 필요 조치를 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 실제 검토가 필요해 보인다”고 했다. 이 대통령의 글에서는 “혐오와 조롱은 표현의 자유가 아니다”라는 찬성 댓글과 “입맛에 맞으면 표현의 자유이고 거스르면 처벌, 그것이 바로 독재의 시작”이라는 반대 댓글이 수천 개 달렸다. 일베 폐쇄는 지난 2018년 문재인 정부 때 국민 청원이 올라와 당시 청와대가 검토했지만 실제 폐쇄로 이어지지는 않았다.)

item.title: [Episode 7] The Chairman Wants to Meet You Personally ([7화] 회장님이 직접 뵙자고 하십니다)
item.description:
[Episode 7] The Chairman Wants to Meet You Personally ([7화] 회장님이 직접 뵙자고 하십니다)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introductions (☞ 등장인물 소개)

A week later, Evan headed to Pangyo. His destination was the 21st floor of Taesan Defense headquarters. He met Choi Sung-jin, Managing Director and head of the Domestic Business Division. The office was even more spacious than he had imagined. Through the window, the Pangyo Techno Valley sprawled below. (일주일 후, 에반은 판교로 향했다. 태산디펜스 본사 21층이 행선지. 국내사업본부장 최성진 상무를 만났다. 집무실은 생각보다 더 넓었다. 창밖으로 판교 테크노밸리가 내려다보였다.)

Managing Director Choi came out to the door himself to greet Evan. When they shook hands, Evan felt a firm grip. Choi handed over his business card with both hands. Over the past month, the two had only communicated via email. Their conversations had been substantial enough to negotiate contract terms, but they hadn't yet reached a level of rapport where they could confide in each other openly. (최 상무는 직접 문 앞까지 나와 에반을 맞았다. 손을 잡았을 때 단단한 느낌이 왔다. 그는 명함을 두 손으로 건넸다. 둘은 지난 한 달간 이메일로만 소통했다. 계약 조건을 조율할 만큼 대화가 오갔지만 이심전심으로 흉금을 터놓을 만한 사이까진 이르지 않았다.)

To start, Evan and Managing Director Choi sat facing each other on the sofa. It seemed informal. But as soon as Choi spoke, it became clear that the sofa arrangement was merely a formality. Choi spoke down to Evan. (일단 에반은 최 상무와 소파에 마주 보고 앉았다. 격식을 따지지 않는 듯했다. 최 상무가 입을 열자 소파 배치는 단지 배치였을 뿐이라는 게 금세 드러났다. 최 상무는 에반을 내려다보듯 말했다.)

"I reviewed your proposal thoroughly. The technology partnership structure was quite interesting." (“제안서 잘 검토했습니다. 기술 파트너십 구조 부분이 흥미롭더군요.”)

Managing Director Choi scrolled through his tablet and paused. (최 상무가 태블릿을 스크롤하다 멈췄다.)

"However, the core keyword for this project is 'self-reliant defense.' The government, the public, and the media are all focused on that. A foreign company taking the lead carries significant political risks. It's not something the Blue House can sign off on." (“다만 이번 사업의 핵심 키워드는 ‘자주 국방’입니다. 정부도, 국민도, 언론도 모두 거기에 초점을 맞추고 있죠. 외국 기업이 전면에 나서는 건 정치적 부담이 큽니다. 청와대가 사인할 사안이 아닙니다.”)

"I understand." (“이해합니다.”)

Prolonging the conversation wouldn't benefit either party. Evan shifted the topic to the business structure. (긴 대화는 피차 도움이 되지 않는다. 에반은 사업 구조로 화제를 옮겼다.)

"What specific structure are you referring to?" (“구체적으로 어떤 구조를 말씀하시는 겁니까?”)

"Taesan will step forward as the prime. System integration, production, and delivery will all be under the Taesan name. Dudal will participate as a technology partner." (“태산이 프라임으로 나섭니다. 시스템 통합, 생산, 납품 모두 태산 명의로. 듀다엘은 기술 파트너로 참여하시는 겁니다.”)

"So Taesan handles hardware manufacturing and system integration, while Dudal’s AI engine is introduced under a licensing model." (“태산이 하드웨어 제조와 시스템 통합을 담당하고, 듀다엘의 AI 엔진은 라이선스 형태로 도입한다.”)

"That's correct." (“그렇습니다.”)

"And the data? Real-time training data. An AI system needs continuous learning to maintain its performance. Where will that data be processed?" (“데이터는요? 실시간 학습 데이터입니다. AI 시스템은 지속적으로 학습해야 성능이 유지됩니다. 그 데이터는 어디서 처리됩니까?”)

Managing Director Choi scratched his nose as he spoke. (최 상무가 코를 긁적거리며 말했다.)

"On servers here in Korea, of course." (“당연히 한국 내 서버에서죠.”)

"Then you would need to build your own independent AI training infrastructure. That requires a massive investment." (“그렇다면 독자적인 AI 학습 인프라를 구축하셔야 합니다. 막대한 투자가 필요합니다.”)

The corners of Managing Director Choi’s mouth tightened slightly. His standard tactic before real negotiations was to make a bold opening move. Maintaining his composure, he pressed on. (최 상무의 입가가 미세하게 굳었다. 실제 협상에 앞서 일단 질러 놓고 보는 게 그의 정석 포진. 평정을 유지한 채 밀어붙였다.)

"Can Dudal support that part?" (“듀다엘이 그 부분을 지원할 수 있습니까?”)

"Technology transfer is not possible under headquarters policy." (“기술 이전은 본사 정책상 불가능합니다.”)

Evan took a breath. (에반이 숨을 한 번 골랐다.)

"Another method is possible. A cloud service model. Taesan fully controls the operational interface. The AI engine runs on Dudal’s infrastructure." (“다른 방식은 가능합니다. 클라우드 서비스 모델. 운영 인터페이스는 태산이 완전히 통제합니다. AI 엔진은 듀다엘 인프라 위에서 돌아갑니다.”)

Managing Director Choi set down his tablet and folded his hands on top of it. It was a signal that the meeting would likely run longer. Evan's preemptive proposal seemed to have slightly veered off his expected scenario. But this day was just a first meeting. It was an exploratory round, not a conclusive one. He had conveyed what the Taesan chairman had instructed, and decided that was enough. (최 상무가 태블릿을 내려놓고 그 위에 양손을 포갰다. 회의가 더 길어질 거라 보는 시그널. 에반의 기습 선제 제안은 그의 예상 시나리오를 살짝 비켜간 모양이다. 하지만 이날은 첫 만남. 탐색전일 뿐 매듭짓는 자리가 아니다. 그는 태산 회장이 시킨 걸 전달했고, 그걸로 충분했다고 판단했다.)

"...We'll need an internal review." (“······내부 검토가 필요하겠습니다.")

The ending signal. The meeting was over. It had lasted 30 minutes from the start. They exchanged a farewell handshake. This time, Managing Director Choi’s fingers were tense with force. (엔딩 시그널. 미팅은 끝났다. 시작한 지 30분. 작별의 악수를 나눴다. 이번엔 최 상무 손끝에 힘이 들어가 있었다.)

That evening, Evan drove an hour from Pangyo to arrive at a private bar in Gwanghwamun. Lee Jin-hyuk, Managing Director of L Group's Strategic Planning Office, stood up from a corner table to greet Evan. He bowed at the waist without lowering it too much—a soft, half-bow greeting that seemed like a uniform worn by those handling government relations. On Lee's table were two glasses of single malt whiskey. His smartphone was lying face down. (그날 저녁, 에반은 판교에서 한 시간을 달려 광화문 프라이빗 바에 도착했다. 이진혁 L그룹 전략기획실 상무가 구석에서 일어나 에반을 맞았다. 허리를 꺾되 굽히지는 않았다. 대관 담당 선수들이 유니폼처럼 걸친 부드러운 반절의 인사였다. 이 상무 테이블에는 싱글 몰트 위스키 두 잔이 놓여 있었다. 이 상무의 스마트폰은 화면이 아래로 뒤집힌 채 놓여 있었다.)

"Getting a Dudal person to sit down in Seoul is harder than landing a government contract. I can count on one hand how many times I've sat across from someone from Dudal. You don't usually come to this side, do you?" (“듀다엘 쪽 사람을 서울에 앉혀 놓기가 정부 계약 따는 것보다 어렵네요. 제가 듀다엘 사람과 마주 앉아본 게 손에 꼽힙니다. 평소에 이쪽으로는 잘 안 오시죠?”)

"There are internal regulations about who I meet and how it's documented. Headquarters doesn't like unexpected schedules." (“누구를 만나고 어떻게 기록하는지에 관한 내부 규정이 있습니다. 본사는 예상 밖 일정을 좋아하지 않습니다.”)

"So, this is a drinking session that won't go on the report." (“그럼 이건 보고서에 안 올라가는 술자리네요.”)

"Just a casual whiskey gathering." (“그냥 위스키 한잔 하는 자리입니다.”)

Managing Director Lee raised his glass. (이 상무가 잔을 들었다.)

"Is everything going well with Taesan?" (“태산이랑은 잘 되고 있습니까?”)

"It's more complicated than I thought. They want the technology but want our name hidden." (“생각보다 복잡합니다. 기술은 넘기고 이름은 숨으라는 쪽이에요.”)

"That's exactly their style. Taesan gets the limelight, and failure lands on the partner. A familiar picture." (“딱 그 스타일이죠. 간판은 태산, 실패는 파트너. 익숙한 그림이네요.”)

"Headquarters needs to maintain control over the technology. The structure Taesan wants is difficult." (“본사는 기술 통제권을 유지해야 합니다. 태산이 원하는 구조는 어렵죠.”)

"So, what are you going to do?" (“그럼 어떻게 하실 겁니까?”)

Evan downed his whiskey. It was a prelude to delivering his next sentence. (에반이 위스키를 들이켰다. 다음 한 문장을 전달하기 위해서다.)

"Because Taesan isn't our only partner." (“태산만이 유일한 파트너는 아니니까요.”)

Managing Director Lee’s fingers holding the glass paused briefly. The reason Lee paid for the night's drinks, which likely cost hundreds of thousands of won, was to hear that very sentence. If not Taesan, there was only one other potential player. (이 상무의 잔을 쥔 손가락이 짧게 멈췄다. 몇 십만 원은 나올 이날 술값을 이 상무가 계산하는 이유도 이 한 문장을 듣기 위해서였다. 태산이 아니라면 다음 플레이어는 한 곳뿐.)

"Woosing." (“우성.”)

He stared intently at Evan. "You know what happens if Chairman Shin hears that name is tied to this project, right?" (그는 진지한 눈길로 에반을 물끄러미 쳐다봤다. “신 회장이 이 프로젝트에 그 이름이 엮여 있다는 말을 들으면 어떻게 되는지 아시잖아요.”)

Woosing Group was Taesan Defense’s biggest rival, locked in a fierce competition for rankings in the business world. Shifting business leadership into that realm was something that would provoke the owner. (우성그룹은 태산디펜스 최대 라이벌이자 재계 서열을 다투는 앙숙이었다. 사업 주도권이 옮겨간다는 건, 오너를 움직이게 하는 영역이다.)

Evan remained silent. He gave an almost imperceptible nod. That was enough. The rest, Managing Director Lee would interpret on his own, key it into his smartphone, and send it off. (에반은 침묵했다. 보일 듯 말 듯 고개를 끄덕였다. 그거면 충분했다. 나머지는 이 상무가 알아서 해석해 스마트폰에 실어 날릴 것이다.)

"Several parties have shown interest. Off the record." (“몇 군데서 관심을 보이고 있습니다. 오프더레코드입니다.”)

"I thought things were going well with Taesan. This is unexpected." (“태산이랑 잘 굴러가는 줄 알았는데. 의외네요.”)

Managing Director Lee offered a faint smile, raised his glass, then stood up from his seat. (이 상무가 희미한 미소를 지으며 잔을 들었다가, 자리에서 일어섰다.)

"Excuse me for a moment, I need to use the restroom." (“잠시 화장실 좀.”)

It was an obvious ploy. He returned in less than three minutes. He had typed a three-line message in the restroom, read it once more, and sent it. That message would travel from Managing Director Lee, through internal channels at L Group, to someone managing the discreet connection leading back to Taesan. By the next morning, it would be on the smartphone of Taesan Chairman Shin. (뻔히 보이는 수였다. 그는 3분도 채 되지 않아 돌아왔다. 화장실에서 세 줄짜리 메시지를 타이핑했고, 한 번 다시 읽은 뒤 보냈다. 그 메시지는 이 상무에서 L그룹 내부, 다시 태산으로 이어진 은밀한 커넥션을 관리하는 누군가에게로, 내일 아침이면 태산 신 회장 스마트폰에 담겨 있을 것이다.)

When Managing Director Lee returned to his seat, he maintained a poker face as if nothing had happened, but it went without saying. The critical information had already been exchanged. For the next hour, the two discussed topics like semiconductor market trends, international oil prices, and rumors of a cabinet reshuffle. (자리로 돌아온 이 상무는 아무 일 없었던 듯 포커 페이스를 유지했지만 불문가지(不問可知)였다. 중요한 정보는 이미 교환된 뒤. 이후 한 시간 동안 둘은 반도체 시황, 국제 유가, 개각 소문 같은 것들을 나눴다.)

Two days later, Evan received a call from an unknown number. (이틀 뒤 에반에게 모르는 번호로 전화가 걸려왔다.)

"Team Leader Evan, this is Choi Sung-jin from Taesan Defense." His voice sounded markedly different from two days ago. (“에반 팀장님, 태산디펜스 최성진입니다.” 이틀 전과는 자못 다른 목소리였다.)

"The Chairman wishes to meet you in person. He said he wants to hear Dudal's position directly, without going through the working-level channels." (“회장님께서 팀장님을 직접 뵙고 싶어 하십니다. 실무 라인을 거치지 않고 듀다엘의 입장을 직접 듣겠다고 하셨습니다.”)

Evan called Jordan. (에반은 조던에게 전화를 걸었다.)

"Shin Jae-hyuk wants to meet me personally." (“신재혁이 직접 만나자고 합니다.”)

item.title: “Is it a policy of submission to communists and oppression of one’s own people?” (“공산주의자에겐 저자세, 동족에겐 탄압 정치냐”)
item.description:
“Is it a policy of submission to communists and oppression of one’s own people?” (“공산주의자에겐 저자세, 동족에겐 탄압 정치냐”)

At 2 PM on May 5, 1983, a Chinese civilian aircraft made an emergency landing at the US military base in Chuncheon. This was during an era when China was referred to as “Communist China.” It was the first time a civilian aircraft from “Communist China,” a country without diplomatic relations, had landed on South Korean soil since the founding of communist China in 1949. The incident was revealed to be the work of six hijackers. (1983년 5월 5일 오후 2시, 중국 민항기가 춘천 주한 미군 기지에 불시착했습니다. 중국을 중공이라고 부르던 시절입니다. 미수교국인 ‘중공’ 민항기가 대한민국 영토에 착륙한 것은 1949년 공산 중국 건국 후 처음이었습니다. 비행기 납치범 6명의 소행인 것으로 밝혀집니다.)

China sent a 33-member negotiation team to South Korea to discuss the repatriation of the crew, passengers, and the aircraft with the South Korean government. In the memorandum of agreement, the official names of both countries were recorded for the first time. However, at a press conference, the head of the negotiation team, Shen Tu, Director General of the Civil Aviation Administration of China, avoided using the term “Republic of Korea” and only referred to “your side.” The South Korean government provided the highest level of treatment to the passengers and the negotiation team, drawing criticism of being “submissive.” The media also covered it as a major story day after day. (중국은 한국에 33명 협상단을 보내 우리 정부와 승무원·승객 및 여객기 송환 협의를 합니다. 합의 각서에 양국의 정식 국호가 처음으로 적혔습니다. 그러나 협상단장인 중국민항총국장 선투(深圖)는 기자회견에서는 대한민국이란 말은 하지 않고 ‘귀측(貴側)’이라고만 했습니다. 정부는 ‘저자세’라는 비판이 나올 정도로 여객기 승객 및 협상단에 최고 대우를 합니다. 언론도 연일 주요 소식으로 전했습니다.)

YS recorded this in his diary, expressing his displeasure. “At the press conference, when asked whether he would use the official name in the future, he did not answer and kept saying ‘your side’ instead of ‘the South Korean side.’” “I’d like to ask: while professing humanitarianism toward communists, is this kind of oppressive politics toward one’s own people humanitarianism?” “As for the government and media, which made a fuss as if they’d found a way to profit from the Communist Chinese, what will they make a fuss about now?” (YS는 일기에 이 사실을 적고 못마땅한 마음을 기록합니다. “기자회견에서 앞으로 정식 명칭을 부를 것이가의 질문에는 답을 하지 않고 한국측이란 말을 끝내 하지 않고 귀측이라고 계속 말한다.” “공산주의자에게도 인도주의를 내세우면서 동족에게는 이렇게 탄압 정치를 하는 것이 인도주의냐고 묻고 싶다.” “중공 사람들 때문에 살 판 생긴 것처럼 떠들어 대던 정부나 언론은 또 무엇을 가지고 떠들 것인지.”)

It has been raining all day since morning. (오늘은 아침부터 계속해서 왼종일 비가 내리고 있다.)

A Chinese civilian aircraft was hijacked by six individuals, including one woman, who demanded to go to Taiwan, and was forced to make an emergency landing near Chuncheon. This plane was en route from Shenyang in Manchuria to Shanghai, and it was revealed that there were 105 passengers on board. (중공민항(中共民航)은 여자(女子) 한 사람을 포함해서 6명(名)의 납치범에 의해서 ‘대만’으로 가자고 요구(要求)해서 강제로 납치되어 춘천(春川) 근교에 비상착륙했다. 이 비행기는 만주 ‘심양’에서 상해(上海)로 가던 길이며 승객(乘客)은 모두 105명(名)이 타고 있었던 것으로 밣어(*밝혀)졌다.)

Two crew members were shot and injured. (승무원(乘務員) 두 사람이 총상을 입었다.)

A phone call came from Kim Dong-young. (김동영(金東英)으로부터 전화가 왔다.)

In the evening, a call came from Mr. Lee Jong-nam, and Song Won-young, who had just returned from the US, also called. (저녁에 이종남(李鍾南) 씨(氏)로부터 전화가 왔고 송원영(宋元英)이가 미국(美囗)에 갔다 왔다 하며 전화가 왔다.)

This morning, I exercised because it wasn’t raining. (오늘 아침에는 비가 나리지 않기 때문에 운동을 했다.)

For a change, today the weather is nice. (모처럼 오늘은 날씨가 좋다.)

Although there’s a bit of wind, it’s clear, so I feel good. (다소의 바람은 있으나 맑아지니까 기분(氣分)이 좋다.)

In the morning, I practiced calligraphy. (오전중(午前中)에는 서도(書道)를 했다.)

Around 12:30 PM, Shen Tu, Director General of the Civil Aviation Administration of Communist China, led 33 people to South Korea for the first time since the establishment of the Communist Chinese regime, to negotiate the repatriation of the passengers, crew, aircraft, and the hijackers involved in this incident. (12시(時) 반(半)경(頃)에 중공(中共)의 민항총국장(民航總局長) 심도(沈圖)가 단장(团長)으로 33명(名)을 거느리고 중공(中共) 정권(政權) 수립(樹立) 이후(以后) 처음으로 한국(韓囗)에 와서 이번에 한국(韓囗)에 불시착(不時着)한 승객(乘客)과 승무원(乘務員) 그리고 기체(機體)와 화이작(*하이재킹)한 사람들의 송환 문제를 협의(協議)하게 된다.)

A call came from Kim Jin-hae of Yecheon. Also, a call from Gyu-hee’s father. (예천의 김진해(金鎭海)씨(氏)로부터 전화가 왔다. 규희 아버지로부터도 전화가 왔다.)

From the US, Eon-cheol and Gyeong-mi called to greet us for Parents’ Day. They said they’re doing well. Since it was Sunday, Lee Seo-bang, Mi-ae, and my wife’s uncle came over, and we all had lunch together. It’s a joyful thing to spend time with one’s children. (미국(美囗)에서 은철이와 경미로부터 어버이날이라고 인사(人事) 전화(電話)가 왔다. 그애들은 잘 있다들한다. 주일(主日)이라 이서방(李書房)과 미애 그리고 처삼촌(妻三寸)이 오셨어(*오셔서) 같이들 점심을 했다. 자식(子息)과 함께 지낸다고 하는 것은 기뿐(*쁜) 일이다.)

To the dictators who preach humanitarianism even to communists, I want to ask: is this kind of oppressive politics toward your own people humanitarianism? If this oppression continues, there is no other path but to collapse miserably in the end. They are following the path of dictators that history speaks of. (독재자들은 공산주의자(共産主義者)에게도 인도주의(人道主義)를 내세우면서 동족(同族)에게는 이렇게 탄압 정치(政治)를 하는 것이 인도주의(人道主義)냐고 묻고 싶다. 이렇게 탄압 정치(政治)가 계속되면 결국 비참하게 쓰러질 수 밖에 딴 길은 없을 것이다. 역사(歷史)가 말하는 독재자의 길을 것고 있는 것이다.)

A call came from Elder Kim Cha-saeng. He said that Elder Kim Un-ho prayed for me during the third service, and I received greetings and Amens from many people. (김차생(金且生) 장로(長老)로부터 전화가 왔다. 김(金)운호 장로(長老)가 삼부(三部) 예배서 나를 위해서 기도를 했어(*해서) 많은 사람들로부터 인사(人事)와 아면(*아멘)을 들었다고 한다.)

A call came from Kim Dong-young. (김동영(金東英)으로부터 전화가 왔다.)

Today, the weather is also nice. (오늘도 날씨는 좋은 날씨이다.)

In the morning, I calmed my mind by practicing calligraphy. A call came from my father thanking me for sending my younger siblings, and he also sent fish. We made it into sashimi and enjoyed it. (오전중(午前中)에는 서도(書道)를 하며 마음을 달랬다. 아버지로부터 동생들을 보내주어 고맙다는 전화가 왔다 그리고 생선을 부처왔다. 맛있게 희(*회)를 해 먹었다.)

I wrote letters to Eon-cheol and Gyeong-mi in the US. It’s been a while since I last wrote. (미국(美囗)의 은철(恩哲)이와 경미(敬美)에게 편지를 했다. 오랜만의 편지를 써봤다.)

In the evening, I replaced the tropical fish with ones that only eat other fish. Also, I removed the lilac tree that had fallen in the wind, and a Mr. Park planted a large persimmon tree and a maple tree we had brought from our house last year. The yard looks very pleasing. (저녁때 열대어 중에서 고기만 잡아 먹고 사는 물고기로만 바꾸었다. 또 지난번에 바람에 쓰러진 라이락 나무를 빼고 큰 감나무와 우리 집에서 작년에 가지고 간 단풍나무를 가져와 박씨(朴氏)가 심어 주었다. 뜰이 퍽 마음에 든다.)

President Jeong Chae-geun called to check on me. (정채근(丁采根) 사장(社長)이 안부 전화가 왔다.)

Today is quite hot. It feels like summer has suddenly arrived. In the morning, I wrote the calligraphy piece that Mr. Go Sun-mun had requested. (오늘은 상당히 더운 날씨다. 여름이 성큼 다가 온 것 같다. 오전중(午前中)에 고(高)순문(文)씨(氏)가 부탁한 서도(書道)를 써서 주었다.)

At around 2:40 PM, Shen Tu, Director General of the Civil Aviation Administration from Communist China, and his entourage of 116 people left Seoul and departed for Communist China. At the final press conference, when asked whether he would use the official name in the future, he did not answer and kept saying “your side” instead of ending with “the South Korean side.” (오후(午后) 2시(時) 40분경(分頃)에 중공(中共)에서 온 민항총국장(民航總局長) 심도(沈圖) 일행(一行) 116명(名)이 서울을 떠 중공(中共)으로 떠났다. 기자회견(記者會見)(마주막)에서 앞으로 정식 명칭을 부를 것이가의 질문에는 답을 하지 않고 한국측(韓囗側)이란 말을 끝내 하지 않고 귀측(貴側)이라고 계속 말한다.)

Letters came from Eon-cheol to me and separately to my younger siblings Hyeon-cheol and Hye-suk. The contents were written so well they brought tears to my eyes. I was deeply moved. From now on, I think I don’t need to worry about Eon-cheol anymore. (은철(恩哲)이로부터 나에게와 동생들 현철(賢哲)이와 혜숙(惠淑)이에게 각각(各〃) 편지가 왔는 내용(內容)이 눈물 겹도록 잘 썼다. 매우 감명을 받았다. 앞으로는 은철(恩哲)이에 대(対)해서는 걱정을 안해도 곈찬켔(*괜찮겠)다.)

A call came from Kim Dong-young. (김동영(金東英)으로부터 전화가 왔다.)

Today, the weather is completely warm like early summer. When I went out into the yard during the day, it was so hot I couldn’t stroll around. (오늘은 날씨가 완전(完全)히 초여름처럼 따스하다. 낮에 마당에 나가니 더워서 거닐 수가 없을 정도다.)

In the morning, as usual, I practiced calligraphy. (오전중(午前中)에는 어느때와 같이 서도(書道)를 했다.)

As for the government and media, which made a fuss as if they’d found a way to profit from the Communist Chinese, what will they make a fuss about now? (중공(中共) 사람들 때문에 살 판 생긴 것처럼 떠더러(*떠들어) 대던 정부(政府)나 언론(言論)은 또 무엇을 가지고 떠덜(*떠들) 것인지.)

Today is very humid and hot. It looks like it could rain any moment. (오늘은 몹시 무더운 날씨다. 금시라도 비가 올 것처럼 보인다.)

As always, I practiced calligraphy in the morning. (언제나와 같이 오전중(午前中)에 서도(書道)를 했다.)

In the afternoon, around 12:30 PM, a call came from Eon-cheol at the home of Aunt Du-a in Washington. It was truly delightful. Du-a said she had invited Eon-cheol and Gyeong-mi to her place. It had been a while since I last heard Du-a’s voice. (오후(午后)에 12시(時) 30분경(分頃) Washington의 두아(斗児) 고모집에 은철(恩哲)로부터 전화가 왔다. 정말 반갑다. 두아(斗児)가 은철(恩哲)이와 경미를 초대해서 두아(斗児)집에 왔다고 한다. 두아(斗児) 목소리도 오랜만에 들었다.)

Mi-ye also came. She has a bad cold. (미예도 왔다. 감기가 몹시 들어있다.)

It looked like rain, but it didn’t come and just passed by. (날씨는 비가 올 듯하더니 비는 오지 않고 그냥 지나간다.)

What is the value of life? (인생(人生)의 삶의 가치는 무엇인가?)

Isn’t living like a human being the most important thing? I think living for social justice and truth for that purpose is the most rewarding life. (인간(人間)답게 사는 것이 가장 중요(重要)한 것이 아니겠느냐? 그것을 위하여 사회(社会)의 정의(正義)와 진실(眞実)을 위하여 사는 것이 가장 보람있는 삶이라고 생각한다.)

Today, I practiced calligraphy again and thought about many things in the afternoon. (오늘도 서도(書道)를 하고 오후(午后)에는 이것저것 많은 것을 생각했다.)

I sent a letter to Eon-cheol. (은철(恩哲)이에게 편지를 붙였다.)

A call came from Kim Dong-young. (김동영(金東英)으로부터 전화가 왔다.)

Fish was sent from Sang-hwan in Busan. (부산(釜山)에 상환(相煥)이로부터 생선이 부처져 왔다.)

Today’s weather isn’t that hot; it feels like the average temperature. (오늘의 날씨는 그렇게 무덥지는 않고 평년기온(平年氣溫) 같다.)

In the morning, I practiced calligraphy again. (오전중(午前中)에는 역시 서도(書道)를 했다.)

While living under house arrest for nearly two years under a dictator, I’ve realized many things from a religious perspective. I think the idea that a person must survive by any means is the worst kind of thinking. We should not live only for ourselves. A true human being must live for our people and neighbors. If that brings suffering, it should not be seen as suffering but as happiness. It should be viewed as glory. I can endure this suffering because I am doing so for justice, according to my conscience, and for the freedom of the people. History has taught us that dictators are bound to fall, and we have seen it with our own eyes. (독재자에 위(*의)해서 2년(年) 가까이 가택연금(家宅軟禁) 생활(生活)을 하면서 종교적(宗敎的)인 면(面)에서 많은 것을 깨달았다. 인간(人間)이 어떤 짓을 해서도 살아야 한다는 생각은 가장 좋지 못한 생각이라고 생각한다. 인생(人生)은 자신(自身)만을 위해서 살아서는 안 된다. 참 인간(人間)은 우리 국민(囗民)과 이웃을 위해서 살아야 한다. 그것 때문에 고통이 온다면 그것은 고통이 아니라 행복(幸福)하게 생각해야 한다. 이것을 영광(榮光)으로 생각해야 한다. 내가 이 고통에서 견디고 있는 것은 양심(良心)에 따라 정의(正義)를 위해서 백성(百姓)의 자유(自由)를 위해서이기 때문에 견딜 수 있는 것이다. 역사(歷史)는 우리에게 독재자는 반드시 멸망하는 것을 가러처(*가르쳐) 주었고 우리도 우리 눈으로 보아왔다.)

History will inevitably proceed justly, based on justice. I believe this. A call came from Kim Jong-hwan in Daegu. (역사(歷史)는 반드시 정의(正義)에 입각해서 정의(正義)롭게 가고야 말 것이다. 나는 이것을 믿는다. 대구(大邱) 김종환(金鍾煥)이로부터 전화가 왔다.)

Many calls came today. Hearing that comrade Kwon Cheol died of shock after a life of hardship, without seeing a good world, truly breaks my heart. Tomorrow is the funeral, and comrades said they would go to the wedding of comrade Yun Tae-un’s son in Cheongju today and then visit comrade Kwon Cheol’s home. Calls came from Director Kim, Kim Dong-young, Hwang Myeong-su, and Elder Kim Cha-saeng. (오늘은 전화가 많이 왔다. 권철(權澈) 동지가 좋은 세상(世上)도 보지 못하고 고생만 하다가 쇽크(*쇼크)로 죽었다고 하는데 대(対)해서 정말 마음 아푸(*프)다. 내일(來日)이 발인이라고 동지(同志)들 오늘은 청주(淸州)에 윤태(尹泰)운 동지 아들의 결혼식(結婚式)에 갔다가 권철(權澈) 동지 댁(宅)을 갈 것이라고 김실장(金室長), 김동영(金東英), 황명수(黃明秀), 김차생(金且生) 장로(長老)로부터 전화가 왔다.)

A call came from the Tokyo bureau chief of D.P.A. news agency, a German wire service in Japan. (일본(日本)에서 독일 통신의 D.P.A통신(通信)의 동경지국장(東京支局長)으로부터 전화가 왔다.)

Since today is Sunday, Elder Kim Cha-saeng prayed for me during the second service, and I received Amens from many people. It is said that Myeong-sun and Hye-suk shed tears of emotion. (오늘은 주일(主日)날이라 2부(部) 예배에서 김차생(金且生) 장로가 나를 위해서 기도를 했서(*해서) 많은 사람들로부터 아면(*아멘)을 받았다고 한다. 명순이와 혜숙이는 감격의 눈물을 흘렸다고 한다.)

As I recall, today is the day of Park Chung-hee’s military coup 21 years ago. It’s the day Park Chung-hee came in and left a dirty habit of soldiers forcibly taking over the country with guns and swords, unrelated to the people. It’s a day I want to forget. (오늘은 21년(年) 전(前)이라고 기억이 되는데 박정희(朴正熙)가 군사(軍事) 구데타를 이러킨(*일으킨) 날이다. 박정희(朴正熙)가 들어 이 나라를 군인들이 총과 칼로 힘으로 강제로 국민(囗民)들과는 관계(關係) 없이 나라를 강점하는 더러운 섭(*습)관을 들인 날이다. 잊어버리고 싶은 날이기도 하다.)

The weather is like early summer again today. Looking up at the puffy clouds in the high sky, my heart feels wide open, and I find peace of mind. Here, I can’t see high mountains, nor can I see big rivers. Not seeing high mountains or big rivers for nearly a year makes me miss them even more. Isn’t that human nature…? What I must always remember is that whatever I do, except for sleep, I must keep doing something. That alone is my greatest weapon for overcoming loneliness. (날씨는 오늘도 초여름 같은 날이다. 높은 하늘에 뭉개뭉개 떠있는 구름을 처(*쳐)다보니 마음 할(*활)짝 열리는 것 같고 마음 편안함 얻게 된다. 여기에서는 높은 산은 보이지 않고 큰 강도 볼 수가 없다. 일년(一年) 가까이를 높은 산을 보지도 못하고 큰강도 보지 못하니까 더욱 보고 싶어진다. 그것이 인간의 말이 아니겠나……. 내가 늘 생각해야 할 것은 내가 무엇을 하던지 자는 시간(時間)을 빼고는 무엇인가 해야 한다. 그것만이가 내가 외로움을 이길 수 있는 가장 큰 무기이기 때문이다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh: “Seoul Discount Is Because of Oh”… Oh Se-hoon: “Jeong, a Puppet of Lee Jae-myung, Is Underqualified” (정원오 “서울 디스카운트는 吳 때문”… 오세훈 “이재명 허수아비 鄭, 함량미달”)
item.description:
Jeong Won-oh: “Seoul Discount Is Because of Oh”… Oh Se-hoon: “Jeong, a Puppet of Lee Jae-myung, Is Underqualified” (정원오 “서울 디스카운트는 吳 때문”… 오세훈 “이재명 허수아비 鄭, 함량미달”)

With two days to go until the main voting day for the Seoul mayoral election, candidates from both parties appealed for support consolidation through walking campaigns across Seoul on the 1st. Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh visited redevelopment unions in Gangnam-gu and Yongsan-gu, which have strong conservative tendencies, emphasizing development pledges, while People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon focused his campaign on northern areas with many pro-government supporters. <<> Candidate Jeong Won-oh campaigned that morning at Dongdaemun Cheongnyangni Fruit and Vegetable Market and Seoul Station. At a press conference in front of Seoul Station, he said, “Please rally support for Jeong Won-oh, who will support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration from Seoul.” Jeong added, “The core of the Seoul Discount is the safety negligence, incompetence, and irresponsibility of Oh Se-hoon’s city administration as Seoul mayor.” <<> Regarding real estate policy, Jeong, as a ruling party candidate, vowed to push forward tailored policies such as redevelopment and reconstruction, private and public apartment supply, and jeonse/monthly rent support through cooperation with the government. That evening, he met with residents of the Eunma Apartment complex in Gangnam-gu, which is pursuing reconstruction, and the Yongsan-gu redevelopment union to explain his urban renewal development pledges. <<> Candidate Oh Se-hoon targeted Jeong that day, saying, “He is a puppet who can’t help but focus on aligning with President Lee Jae-myung’s agenda.” In response to Jeong’s claim of a “Seoul Discount” directed at him, Oh retorted, “The Seoul Discount is likely to truly begin when an underprepared and underqualified candidate becomes mayor of Seoul.” Oh focused his campaign that day on northern Seoul areas classified as tough districts, including Gangbuk-gu, Dobong-gu, Nowon-gu, and Jungnang-gu. <<> Former President Lee Myung-bak visited Seoul Forest in Seongdong-gu that morning, saying, “We need to elect a mayor and district chief who do their jobs well,” supporting Oh. Seoul Forest, opened in 2005, was a project during Lee’s tenure as Seoul mayor. Seongdong-gu is where Jeong Won-oh served as district chief. Lee remarked, “When Seoul Forest was being built, there were many opponents, but once it was completed, it became a wonderful park where all Seoul citizens can conveniently come and go.” <<> However, both candidates shifted to a “quiet campaign” after news of the explosion at Hanwha Aerospace’s Daejeon plant was reported that afternoon. Jeong canceled his scheduled vehicle campaign and met citizens on foot instead. Oh’s campaign also announced a ban on dance routines and campaign jingles. (서울시장 선거 본투표를 이틀 앞둔 1일 여야 후보는 서울 전역을 훑는 도보 유세로 지지층 결집을 호소했다. 더불어민주당 정원오 후보는 보수세가 강한 강남구와 용산구 재건축조합을 찾아 개발 공약을 강조했고, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 여권 지지층이 많은 강북 지역을 중심으로 유세를 펼쳤다.)

item.title: Fighting for Every Last Percent... Rival Parties Go All-Out on Eve of Local Elections (1%라도 더… 여야 ‘지방선거 D-1’ 총력전)
item.description:
Fighting for Every Last Percent... Rival Parties Go All-Out on Eve of Local Elections (1%라도 더… 여야 ‘지방선거 D-1’ 총력전)

On the first day of June, two days before the June 3 local elections, the rival parties launched their final all-out campaigns. The leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea toured regions, promising "budget support." The People Power Party apologized, saying "We fell short," while appealing, "Please allow us to check the reckless one-man rule of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (6·3 지방선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일 여야가 막판 총력전에 나섰다. 더불어민주당 지도부는 지역을 돌며 ‘예산 지원’을 약속했다. 국민의힘은 “우리가 부족했다”고 사과하면서 “이재명 정권의 독주를 견제할 수 있게 해달라”고 호소했다.)

At a party central election committee meeting held in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae said, "The budget will be drawn up under the Lee Jae-myung administration and passed by the Democratic Party in the National Assembly," urging, "Please vote for candidate number one for a powerful ruling party and the stable governance of the Lee Jae-myung administration." During a campaign rally in Hongseong County, South Chungcheong Province on May 29, Chung stated, "(The government and ruling party) will unleash a budget bombshell to dazzlingly develop Hongseong." <<> People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok and policy committee chairman Jeong Jeom-sik held a press conference at the National Assembly that day, saying, "We are well aware that many see the People Power Party as lacking. We apologize and regret this." Floor leader Song added, "The authoritarian attitude of attempting to withdraw an indictment to cover up one person's crime by mobilizing power is the essence of the Lee Jae-myung regime," urging, "Please cast a vote for candidate number two to provide at least minimal checks on this arrogant power." <<> Initially, there were many predictions in political circles that the Democratic Party would achieve a landslide victory in these local elections. However, as the push for a special counsel law to investigate the "fabricated indictment" that could lead to the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung gained traction, and the argument for checking the ruling power emerged, the Democratic Party is now emphasizing the stock market surge and promising regional budget support in its final campaign efforts. In contrast, the People Power Party is focusing on the special counsel law for fabricated indictments, the government-level boycott of Starbucks, and the burden on people's livelihoods from high prices and a high exchange rate. <<> ◇ Ruling Party: "Vote for Us, and We'll Provide Budget Bombshell Support"... Opposition: "Buying Votes with Taxpayer Money" <<> The Democratic Party leadership has been emphasizing "budget bombshells" during recent regional campaign rallies. On May 31, leader Chung Cheong-rae said in Geumsan, South Chungcheong Province, and Gurye, South Jeolla Province, "If you vote for the Democratic Party candidate, we will designate this area as a basic income region for farming and fishing communities." <<> The Lee Jae-myung administration is currently operating a basic income project for farming and fishing communities in 10 counties nationwide, distributing 150,000 won per month to all county residents for two years in the form of local gift certificates. Amid the so-called "war supplementary budget" due to the Iran situation, it was decided to select around five additional locations this year, and 44 areas applied. The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs had previously stated it would form an evaluation committee centered on civilian experts to select the project areas. <<> Recently, the Democratic Party has also been promising "central party-level budget support" for local issues. When the Democratic Party candidate for mayor of Gyeryong promised to relocate the Gyeryong Spa Tel, a military resort facility previously used as a presidential lodging, from Daejeon to Gyeryong, leader Chung stated, "We will provide budget and institutional support at the central party level," which sparked backlash in Daejeon. Floor leader Han Byeong-do on May 30 promised large-scale budgets in Seosan, South Chungcheong Province, including support for the Daesan Industrial Complex and the opening of Seosan Airport. <<> President Lee Jae-myung also stated at a cabinet meeting on May 26, "To elevate the southeastern region into a global maritime economic zone, we must swiftly pursue the additional relocation of other public institutions or companies that have long been under consideration." Additionally, the President visited Busan and South Gyeongsang Province four times over the past month. A ruling party official commented, "The President's visit to Busan has raised expectations among Busan citizens regarding the relocation of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries." <<> In response to these actions by the government and ruling party, the People Power Party criticized them as "vote-buying with the budget." The argument is that while budgets must be finalized and executed through National Assembly deliberation, the Democratic Party, holding a majority, has effectively declared it will "spend the budget as it pleases" ahead of the elections. <<> People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon told this newspaper, "The national budget is not the exclusive property of any particular party or political force, but the people's tax money," calling it "irresponsible politics that show off by handing out people's tax money, which is not their own, and ultimately burden them with a tax bombshell." He described it as "a dangerous declaration of intent to use power for elections," urging "wise voters to put a stop to it." <<> The Democratic Party is also emphasizing the "argument for regime stability," citing the soaring stock market as a government achievement. The KOSPI index closed at a record high of 8788.38 points on June 1. On May 29, leader Chung Cheong-rae said, "Those who have profited from the KOSPI rise or feel pleased looking at their stock accounts, please vote for the Democratic Party." Since President Lee was party leader, the Democratic Party has focused on winning over the 14 million individual stock investors by pushing for the abolition of the financial investment income tax and amendments to the Commercial Act. <<> In response, the People Power Party is countering by emphasizing high prices, the jeonse and monthly rental housing crisis, and tax increases. On June 1, the People Power Party launched an online national petition campaign related to the Ministry of Justice's extension of the suspension period for Prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who investigated the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case involving President Lee. The People Power Party stated, "This ultimately means they intend to 'cancel the trial' of President Lee's case." <<> The People Power Party is also fiercely attacking the recent release on bail of Jeong Young-hak and Jeong Min-yong, members of the Daejang-dong cartel. All individuals involved in the Daejang-dong case have been released, and with the prosecution abandoning the appeal in the Daejang-dong case, it has become impossible to recover the hundreds of billions of won in profits. (민주당 정청래 대표는 이날 충남 천안에서 열린 당 중앙선거대책위원회 회의에서 “예산은 이재명 정부에서 편성해 민주당이 국회에서 통과시킨다”며 “힘 있는 여당, 이재명 정부의 안정적인 국정 운영을 위해 기호 1번에 투표해달라”고 했다. 정 대표는 지난 29일 충남 홍성군 유세에선 “(정부·여당이) 예산 폭탄을 내려 홍성을 눈부시게 성장시키겠다”고 했다.)
